children: Welcome to our weekly ChartWatch *LIVE* Webinar series. Hundreds of Aussie investors joined me at lunchtime to learn more about technical analysis by using the ASX stocks they’re interested in as case studies.
But that’s the point of ChartWatch *LIVE* – it’s not up to me to set the agenda – it’s up to you! 🫵
Click the "Watch on YouTube" button in the player above, or go to our YouTube page, to check out our other fantastic technical analysis videos when you're done with this one!

If you attended, I trust that you enjoyed the session and leant plenty about how to think and act like a trend following technical analyst. If you weren't able to make it, or if you haven't registered yet, then I hope you can join me Wednesday, 16 September, at 12:00pm AEDTfor the next instalment. Be sure to bring an open mind about investing plus two of your favourite ASX stocks for me to analyse!
In this week's edition (click links to jump to a segment of the video 📺!)
00:10:55 Index Wrap (Dow Jones Industrial Average, Russell 2000, S&P 500 Equal Weight Index)
00:14:40 Bond Yields, Inflation Expectations & Oil Price Wrap
00:18:20 Commodity Wrap (Coking Coal, Thermal Coal, European Energy Prices, Uranium, Iron Ore, Copper, Gold, Silver, Base Metals)
00:55:50 Global X Battery Tech & Lithium ETF (ACDC)
00:59:35 PMET Resources (PMT), Vulcan Energy Resources (VUL) and Wildcat Resources (WC8)
01:02:25 HOW TO GET CARL'S TREND RIBBONS

Learn more about technical analysis and trend following through real case studies on ASX stocks. Australia's premier technical analyst, Carl Capolingua, shares his unique insights on stocks as requested by viewers. Ask about a company in your portfolio or anything related to trading and investing and get Carl's expert opinion.
Stocks are sagging under the weight of rising crude oil prices, fraying investor nerves over inflation and helping drive bond yields higher – have markets passed the point of no return?

But there are still winners, with investors buying aggressively in commodities like copper and coal – benchmark futures contracts for both have spiked over the past week. We check out the hottest ASX copper and coal stocks.

With the lithium price approaching a critical inflection point, we investigate a reliable technical analysis model for identifying when a bull market turns into a bear market, as well as the latest charts on the ASX lithium sector.

title: Are ASX shares headed for a crash? This expert says it's time to protect your capital (and he shows you how to do it)
